name: What is the difference between stock, semi-custom, and custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between stock, semi-custom, and custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stock cabinets are pre-built to standard dimensions and offer the fastest lead times at the lowest price point, though they provide limited sizing and finish options. Semi-custom cabinets offer standard box sizes with customizable door styles, finishes, and modified depths, striking a balance between budget and flexibility. Custom cabinets are built from scratch to your exact kitchen dimensions, making them ideal for non-standard room layouts, historic homes, or ceiling-height storage, but they require the longest lead times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stock cabinets come in set sizes with standard finishes; semi-custom offers adjustable dimensions and more styles; custom units are built to exact room specifications.
